login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Use your PDS account
login.verifyBar: Verify the address bar before entering your password.
login.passkeyFirst: Enter your username or email address first

factor.title: Confirm it's you
factor.emailSubtitle: We emailed a one-time code for {{handle}}.
factor.totpSubtitle: Enter the code from your authenticator app or a recovery code.

authorize.title: Authorize access
authorize.revokeNote: You can revoke this application later from your account page.
authorize.signInAgainNote: This application asks you to sign in again to continue.
authorize.identityOnly: This application only confirms your account identity.

settings.recoveryCodesBody: Save these one-time codes somewhere safe. Each unlocks your account once if you lose the authenticator.
settings.noPasskeys: No passkeys yet. Add one to sign in without a password.
settings.passkeyAdded: Passkey added. You can use it the next time you sign in.
settings.totpProtects: An authenticator app protects your sign-in.
settings.emailProtects: Email verification codes protect your sign-in.
settings.emailOffConfirm: Turn off email verification for sign-in?
settings.emailOffDone: Email verification turned off. You can now add an authenticator.
settings.scanThis: Scan this with Google Authenticator or a compatible app, then confirm with a code.
settings.cannotScan: Cannot scan it? Enter this secret by hand instead.
settings.totpEnabled: Authenticator enabled. Save your recovery codes before leaving.
settings.totpOffConfirm: Remove your authenticator and invalidate its recovery codes?
settings.protectHint: Protect sign-in with one-time codes from an authenticator app.
settings.noApps: No applications are connected through OAuth.
settings.recoveryKeysBody: Independent public keys that can recover your did:plc identity if this server disappears. The server always keeps its own control key.
settings.noRecoveryKeys: No independent recovery keys are configured.
settings.retryHint: You can retry the saved change.
settings.finishHint: Finish it before making another change.
settings.emailRequested: Verification email requested. Use the latest identity-operation code from your inbox.
settings.keysAlready: These recovery keys are already configured.
settings.changeSaved: Your change is saved. Refresh its status or retry the saved change.
settings.replaceConfirm: Replace your identity recovery keys with this ordered list?
settings.removeConfirm: Remove all independent identity recovery keys? The server keeps its control key.
settings.replacementKeys: Replacement keys (one did:key per line, empty to remove all)

schema.identifierRequired: Enter your username, email address, or DID
schema.usernameShape: Use letters, numbers, and inner hyphens
schema.emailLong: That email address is too long
schema.inviteLong: That invite code is too long
schema.totpShape: Enter a 6-digit code or a recovery code
schema.keysLong: That key list is too long
schema.keysShape: Enter up to four distinct public did:key values, one per line
schema.usernameMin: Usernames need at least three characters

forgot.sent: If that address has an account here, a reset link is on its way.
forgot.failed: The reset request could not be sent. Try again.

reset.title: Reset password
reset.subtitle: Choose a new password for your account.
reset.done: Your password is changed. Sign in with the new one.
reset.failed: That link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one from the sign-in page.

confirm.title: Confirm email
confirm.subtitle: One click confirms the address this message was sent to.
confirm.failed: That link is invalid or has expired. Request a new confirmation email from your account page.
